project: The Bureau of Invalidated Tickets / AFTER USE
synthesis_method: Affinity grouping of the artist-researcher's 20 saved reason notes. The four categories are analytic groupings, not participant-derived findings or model-performance scores.

categories.label: OCR and text recognition
categories.interpretation: Missing, corrupted or misclassified text weakens identity, quantity and series relations.

categories.label: Object and image boundary
categories.interpretation: Merged objects, incomplete crops or low-resolution inputs destabilise the unit of analysis.

categories.label: Layout, sequence and structure
categories.interpretation: Linear text output flattens historical reading direction, graphic layers and form structure.

categories.label: Semantic and ontology omission
categories.interpretation: Function, date, explicit absence, material context or institutional class remains outside the current representation.

candidate_intervention.name: Evidence sufficiency gate
candidate_intervention.scope: Change only the output decision layer; keep the same 185 inputs, OCR, segmentation and relation metrics.
candidate_intervention.rule: When a relation lacks a readable or internally consistent core semantic anchor, return pending / insufficient evidence instead of a resolved relation.
candidate_intervention.hypothesis: The gate may reduce overconfident relations without claiming to improve raw OCR accuracy.
evaluation: Compare resolved versus deferred relations on the same fixed input set.
Re-review the same 20 cases using the existing diagnostic criteria.
Record false deferrals as well as cases where uncertainty becomes more legible.

boundary: This synthesis organises one artist-researcher's bounded review. It is not a participant study, population-level validation or completed Run 03 result.
